provider: Original numerical reconstruction of the engineering profile reproduced by Ethem Ersöz, METU2006
source_title: Ethem Ersöz, Development of a racing strategy for a solar car, METU mechanical engineering thesis,2006
vertical_datum: Metres above the reconstructed minimum at the T9 approach; no absolute datum or scenery-grid conversion is inferred from this diagram.
interpolation: Periodic Lipschitz min/max distance envelopes at the independently published operator grade bound; midpoint minimises the maximum height error. Circular Gaussian sigma15m then supplies continuous vertical transitions without increasing the grade bound. The former DSM road is not an input.

digitisation.method: Extract the original embedded diagram from PDF page22. For each profile column, median the red stroke pixels in the lower graph; an11-column median removes stroke/JPEG jitter. Read all18 printed chainage ticks. The thesis explicitly corrects the side-view1140m label to1040m. Both sourceSF intervals0–250m/5070–5377m are horizontal at the same1174px baseline: their common median removes stroke quantisation and the final endcap bias. No other section is flattened.
digitisation.station_registration: Piecewise registration of the published plan/chainage landmarks onto the retained native plan: T1 entry300, T2 valley565, T3 crest1090, T7 valley2000, T8 entry2390/exit2750, T9 valley3385, T11 kink4000, T12 approach4760 and T14 exit5000m. Nativeorigin and5338m lap are unchanged; the source5377m diagram is not uniformly stretched into a surveyed route.

uncertainty_note: The drawing is an engineering-course summary rather than an as-built digital survey. Named corner/crest registration is approximately25–60m uncertain; a common height calibration differs from its two prose measurements by+.828/−.804m. The final bounded profile stays within1.522m of every digitised height.

operator_crosscheck.note: Operator8.145% grade is an independent physical constraint. It is fitted to the primary drawing, not imposed by clipping the former DSM racing profile.

rejected_sources.printed_numeric_gradient_vector: See elevation-research.json. Integrating AppendixA constant intervals closes+5.8845m and incorrectly treats annotated gradients as exact interval-average heights. The closed drawn profile plus two prose height differences supersedes this vector.
rejected_sources.glo30_racing_profile: The retained30m surface raster has roof/vegetation and road-edge influences. It produced−22.93/+22.19% grades, including false humps on the level SF straight. It remains a separately attributed scenery source, not racing-road evidence.

limitations: The field-manager43m and Red Bull Racing46m published relief descriptions conflict with the historical operatorabout60m claim. The measured diagram reconstructs47.89m, within about2m of the team figure. No range is forcibly scaled to any of those rounded claims.
A classified-ground/as-built road survey would supersede this reconstruction. The graphic does not establish millimetre bumps, exact kerb heights or crossfall.

Only the longitudinal road source changes. Banking, widths, centreline and physical protection remain unchanged by this correction. The scenery DSM needs a separate datum alignment after the road is exported.
